items.title: Paul Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: My wife is a singer, Annette Warren

ctx.x: Yeah. You’re walking a fine line between leading them—

And the real good singers are really no problem. The ones that really have talent are very easy to work with. The ones that don’t have talent are the ones that are difficult because they’re insecure up there. And singing is a whole different musical situation. My wife is a singer, Annette Warren, and her description of being up there with your bare face hanging out is different than me — I have a piano between me and an audience. But when you’re out there, there you are, and you’re at the mercy of that guy…
Well you’ve certainly played behind some of the greats. When you were growing up in Southern California, what kind of music were you hearing over the airwaves?
